title: office.attach request
description: Pick at most 8 Library files for a task and copy them into it as task artifacts under context/. Give task; without task, dry_run with text or tags previews a selection and copies nothing.

task.description: The Orbit task id. Its title, description and tags drive the selection: source:<id> tags name its sources, series:<name> tags its artifact series, and runbook ids (runbook:<id>, rb-… tags or ids in its text) its runbooks. An unknown task is refused with task_not_found before any copy.

text.description: Extra text to match, added to the task's own.

tags.description: Extra tags, added to the task's own.

dry_run.description: Return the selection without copying anything (default false).
